title: Founder Live Handoff
objective: Convert P101 founder live-use readiness into governed local handoff artifacts for future agent work without enabling unsafe execution.
safetyRules: No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence/audit/activity helpers

subphases.title: Contract / Scope / Safety Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define P102 founder live handoff scope, safety baseline, subphase split, expected data shapes, validation requirements, and roadmap handoff before behavior changes.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureEnvelope: P102.2 must define a local result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, founderContextSummary, prdReadiness, handoffLanes[], approvalBoundary, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No UI change in P102.1. Future P102 UX must show founder handoff state, current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity, and cost without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw private IDs, demo leakage, or runnable execution actions.
subphases.themeRequirements: No theme source change in P102.1. Future UX must preserve system, dark, and light themes.
subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P102.1 because no UI files change. P102.4 must add focused route coverage.
checkerUpdates: Update check:os-phase-status to accept P102.1-P102.7 and P103.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Add P102 plan doc and platform roadmap section.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P102 in progress; P102.1 complete; current P102.1; previous P101.7; next P102.2.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder live handoff contract"
